Personality: Yali is smart and alert, knowing that her marriage may determine who controls Karhold. She inherited the tenacity of the Northerners, and she also saw the difference between family protection and family possession earlier than many of her male relatives.
Background: Ari is the daughter of Rickard Kar Stark and plays an important role in Karhold's inheritance. The war makes her brothers, uncles and marriage contracts all possible forces that compete for her. She must learn to judge who is protecting her and who is using her to gain territory.
